representation.stress_tensors: 3x3 matrices; first Piola is a two-point tensor with spatial row and reference column
representation.derived_fields: principal values, von Mises, deviatoric stress and scalar invariants are derived from the explicitly named source measure; no cross-measure averaging

aggregate_policy.integration_average: existing reference quadrature weights, applied independently to each explicitly named tensor field
aggregate_policy.nodal_results: existing element-side constant recovery from the integration-average result; metadata identifies the underlying measure and frame
aggregate_policy.not_available_policy: report an explicit availability status and reason; never emit a valid-looking empty array for an uncomputed field

compatibility.migration: No implicit migration. Formulation, state, stress-semantic and result-schema versions must match the corrected route.

properties.corrected_PK2_and_Cauchy_symmetry: verified on bounded corrected element fixtures by unsymmetrized raw transforms and explicit skew guards
properties.stress_aggregation_semantics: all generic aggregate stress-derived fields use Cauchy; measures are retained separately
properties.qualification: No result contract or numerical test promotes maturity or qualification.
